configurePresets.name: msbuild-msvc
configurePresets.description: Generates Visual Studio 2022 x64 solution with vcpkg. Does not set build type here.
$comment: MSBuild uses the same configuration for Debug and Release.
For the generator, you can use Visual Studio 17 2022 or Visual Studio 17 2026.
You can delete the generator key and CMake will use the latest one it finds.

configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc-debug
configurePresets.description: Generates Ninja files for Debug build with vcpkg. Requires active MSVC environment.

configurePresets.name: ninja-msvc-release
configurePresets.description: Generates Ninja files for Release build with vcpkg. Requires active MSVC environment.

buildPresets.name: msbuild-msvc-debug

buildPresets.name: msbuild-msvc-release
buildPresets.description: Builds the MSBuild project in Release mode.

buildPresets.name: ninja-msvc-debug
